Segment B has one hundred thousand people; sixty percent buy, each making twelve purchases a year at ten dollars each. The segments do not overlap, all assumptions are exact, and there is no other spending or sales tax. What is combined annual spending, in millions of dollars?

follow_up.question: Why size the two segments separately?
follow_up.reference: Their buyer rates, purchase frequencies or prices differ. Combining them too early can apply an average assumption to the wrong weight and distort total spending.
